Nitro v3.11.3 `arbos/parse_l2.go`: `case L2MessageKind_UnsignedUserTx` `:245`, its `From: poster` `:248`; `case L2MessageKind_ContractTx` `:256`, `From: poster` `:263`, the literal ends `:269`; go-ethereum fork `core/types/arb_types.go:61-70` (`skipNonceChecks`: Unsigned `:65` false, Contract `:66`, Retry `:67`, SubmitRetryable `:68`, Deposit `:69`, Internal `:70` true). `CertenAccountV7_3.sol` (the cited lines are identical at 57153e5 and d7e9c61): events `GovernanceOperationExecuted` `:258-264`, `GovernanceBatchExecuted` `:265-270`, `LeafConsumed` `:271`; `AuthorityLevel level = authorityLevelOfPage(...)` `:450` (single) and `:482` (batch); emits `:460` (`GovernanceOperationExecuted(adiURL, target, value, data, level)`), `:461` (`LeafConsumed`), `:497` (per leg), `:500` (`GovernanceBatchExecuted(adiURL, proof.anchorId, len, level)`), `:501` (`LeafConsumed`); the `:472` and `:488` that the review's D6 cites are not emit lines. `cast keccak` of the canonical signatures: `GovernanceOperationExecuted(string,address,uint256,bytes,uint8)` = `0x74b66e509fa5263d4932860a2e1f6d187381ae68dee216710283b8677703ff12`; `GovernanceBatchExecuted(string,bytes32,uint256,uint8)` = `0xcbcdc100c8089d25ab823b5044f746670e86a90b18c729bc7d27b7ce78733c56`; `LeafConsumed(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32)` = `0xf65d46899882fe56bab13370dcd464db22e179625c161992c07d962286f7ea73` (equal to M12). ## Open questions (not established; what would establish each) and the status of r1's - closed in r3 [r3:J]

Every entry below ends r3 as **ANSWERED(evidence)**, **NOT NEEDED(reason)**, **OWNER-GATED(id)** or **FIRST-LIVE-CAPTURE(AT-n)**; the last is a fact only the first live capture can produce, so it carries a named acceptance threshold (a decision, OD-S8-24) and the named state that results if the threshold is missed. No entry is "open" without a named owner and a named acceptance test.

- **OQ-S8-1 ANSWERED (M11).** One shared Postgres `certen_proofs` for all seven validators and the proof service.
- **OQ-S8-2 NOT NEEDED for E1/E2 (D11).** Dropped; it survives only as a premise of the reserved later-static station (OD-S8-11): EIP-6780 activation per chain, to be cited into a manifest row if that station is ever built.
- **OQ-S8-3 ANSWERED (M17).** Registry hex == on-chain `bytes` (7/7); lowercase, `0x` stripped.
- **OQ-S8-4 FIRST-LIVE-CAPTURE(AT-4).** Tx + receipt proof sizes, factory proof sizes and per-hop sizes (hop estimate ~5 KB). Owner: WP-S8-3a/3b/3c measure, WP-S8-10 accepts. **AT-4:** per chain at least 10 live containers; accepted when the p95 container size is <= 1 MiB (4x headroom under the 4 MiB cap) and a hop is <= 8 KB; missed -> the cap discussion becomes a verifier-release decision, and a container above 4 MiB is `evidence_too_large{part,count,limit}` at the builder (never truncated).
- **OQ-S8-5 NOT NEEDED for S8 (F-S8-8, R-INNER).** Whether the Groth16 circuit constrains the inner `signedVotingPower/totalVotingPower`: contract/circuit review; S8 reports inner vs outer (step 19f).
- **OQ-S8-6 ANSWERED for Sepolia and pre-Denim Base (M25); FIRST-LIVE-CAPTURE(AT-6) for post-Denim Base.** Public-chain event pairing (no production read): Sepolia (300,000 blocks, 14 pairs) first-settlement gap p50 1 / p95 2 / max 2 blocks = 12 / 36 / 36 s, last-leg gap p50 1 / p95 3 / max 3 blocks (48 s); Base Sepolia pre-Denim (1,000,000 blocks, 3 pairs) 2 blocks = 4 s. No post-Denim settlement exists yet. The hop chain handles any gap (design bound: the leaf `notAfter` and `proof.expiresAt`), so the distribution only sizes `max_attest_hops`. **AT-6:** at least 10 post-Denim Base pairs in RB13; accepted when the maximum gap is below 15 x W (15 hops of 27.3 min = 6.8 h, one hop of margin below `max_attest_hops` 16); missed -> `attest_block_out_of_reach` is the legs' named state and `max_attest_hops` is raised by a verifier release.
- **OQ-S8-7 OWNER-GATED(OQ-R11-3 = Owner-gated item 4).** Whether CERTEN's own Adiri node is running, its version and its `eth_getProof` window. Acceptance: owner probe shows window >= 1 block at head-1. Named state if missed: Adiri attest part `unproven{attest_block_state_unavailable}`; Adiri `verified` is blocked, the implementation is not. (At M11 time `certen-adiri-node` was `Exited (0)` under the owner's maintenance; no conclusion drawn.)
- **OQ-S8-8 ANSWERED (M12), with limits.** 0 wrapper settlements in 133; the open residue is the Base population outside the V11 factory and the production settlement table (not read).
- **OQ-S8-9 FIRST-LIVE-CAPTURE(AT-9).** Whether `ProofExecuted`-triggered capture in every validator stays inside the Arbitrum 25 s window under load (S6's per-chain concurrency of 4, `replaycapture.go:839`, applies; the R10 public window was ~100 blocks = 26 s at 3.83 blocks/s, M14; [r3.1:D1] M31 shows that the Arbitrum providers differ and are not monotonic in depth, so the window is RE-MEASURED before AT-9 is accepted). Owner: WP-S8-3b load test with the replay clock, WP-S8-10 accepts. **AT-9 prerequisite [r3.1:D1]: WP-S8-3b first re-measures `eth_getProof` depth and rate limits of every candidate Arbitrum Sepolia provider with the M31 method and records the table in its check-in; the thresholds below are accepted only against that table.** **AT-9:** at least 40 consecutive live Arbitrum attestations with pre and post captured in >= 95% and capture wall-clock p95 <= 15 s; missed -> the miss is stored as `Stated{attest_block_state_unavailable}` with the providers' errors and OD4 (an archive-class provider, Owner-gated item 3) becomes the fix.
- **OQ-S8-10 ANSWERED (M23, M24, M29-M31) [r3.1:D1].** ONE rule for every type of every chain: `covered` / `system` needs a pinned source AND an on-chain observation (table "Transaction types per chain"). Final `policy.txScan` (manifest item 2): Arbitrum Sepolia covered `0x0 0x2 0x4 0x65 0x66 0x68`, system `0x64 0x69 0x6a`, unsupported `0x1 0x78` (0x1: the source covers it but no 0x1 transaction was found in 9,380 scanned blocks nor in V-S8SPEC-3's ~300 non-empty blocks; 0x78 never appears in a Nitro block; 0x3 cannot appear); Sepolia covered `0x0-0x4`; Base Sepolia covered `0x0 0x2 0x4 0x7e`, unsupported `0x1 0x3`; Adiri covered `0x0 0x2`, unsupported `0x1 0x3 0x4`. r3's availability claim for old Arbitrum state (the stated reason that 0x65 and 0x66 could not be probed) was false and is withdrawn: blocks 315677780 (0x65) and 315677781 (0x66) are served by two providers and the sender nonces are proven under the header roots (M29). Derivation of the Nitro release: `ArbSys.arbOSVersion()` = 116 on Arbitrum Sepolia (block 322138156), `116 - 55` = ArbOS 61, the ArbOS 61 release page names Nitro 3.11.3 as the minimum, tag v3.11.3 (commit 4130f4c5, go-ethereum fork f3a966e6).
- **OQ-S8-11 FIRST-LIVE-CAPTURE(AT-11).** Production rate of `unproven{intra_block_window}` and `attest_block_out_of_reach` after deployment. Owner: WP-S8-5 production-shape check and WP-S8-10. **AT-11:** over the first RB13 live batch (at least 20 legs per chain) `intra_block_window` U <= 5% and `attest_block_out_of_reach` <= 1% of legs; missed -> a coverage package (types, hop cadence) is opened; the named states stay exactly as specified.
- **OQ-S8-12 OWNER-GATED(Owner-gated item 7).** Owner rotation procedure for `policy.owner` (OD-S8-15): a rotation of `0x91C7...c059` must be preceded by a manifest append and verifier release, or every later leg is refused `authorization_mismatch{anchor_owner}`. Acceptance: the owner confirms the process.
- **OQ-S8-13 ANSWERED (identification, M27); the catalogue row belongs to WP-S8-0a-ii (AT-13).** Selector `0x5b1264bc` is `CertenAccountV7.executeGovernanceProofDirect(address,uint256,bytes,ADIGovernanceProof)` with the V7 struct that ends in `AuthorityLevel requiredLevel` (`evm/src/account/CertenAccountV7.sol:109-122,318-336`; `cast sig` = `0x5b1264bc`, batch `0xb9408c5b`); the source is in the repository, NOT in `Archive-legacy`. Semantics fixed in r3: such a leg is `U account_generation_unpinned{kind}` (S6 is silent for it, step 3 row table), and its authority level is submitter-declared (`proof.requiredLevel`, `:327`), so no authority level is ever claimed for it. **AT-13:** the masked hash of `cast code` of 3 Sepolia emitters of that selector and of the factory (V9 or V10) that deployed them is compared with the V7 build by the generator: equal -> a `catalogued` row; unequal or not reproducible -> an `observed` row; either way the verifier outcome is unchanged (`U`).
- **S6.StateRoot accessor (the review's open-question table) NOT NEEDED [r3:S2-4 iii].** `S6.ProvenAt.hash == Leg.blockHash` already pins the state root (a header hash commits to it) and otherwise `S6.CodeHash` is compared with the code proven at N, so `LegContext` needs no state root of S6 and `pkg/ethproof` needs no accessor (no consensus-format dispatch).

## Owner-gated items (the only things an agent cannot do)

1. **Merges** of every PR in the work-package list (touchpoint 1).
2. **The one deploy** (validators `/root/certen-validators`, 7 containers) with the S8 migration staged first by the owner's pre-merge script; the migration is numbered at merge (**next free migration number at merge**, not a fixed number).
3. **OD4 provider key** (owner approved 2026-10-18; the key is a secret): needed for depth-1 pre-state reads on Sepolia and the 25 s Arbitrum windows. [r3.1:D1] The Arbitrum part of that sizing rests on the WP-S8-3b depth / rate-limit re-measurement (M31), not on the R10 figure.
4. **Adiri own node** (OQ-R11-3 = OD-S8-12 = OQ-S8-7): blocks Adiri `verified` in the DoD, not the implementation.
5. **Second Adiri account** only if two real accounts per chain are required (RB12-B finding 4; needs a transaction).
6. **Acknowledgement of named limits and residuals:** (a) `attest_block_out_of_reach` for legs whose tick chain broke or that pre-date E1b; (b) R-PKC, R-INNER, R-SETTLE-POINTER, R-WRITERS [r3.1:D5] as printed residuals; (c) OD-S8-7 scope note (OutcomeRegistry out of v1); (d) the OD-S8-11 reading (D14) in the run log.
7. **Owner rotation procedure** for `0x91C7...c059` (OQ-S8-12): manifest append and verifier release before the first leg attested under a new owner.
